scope: Whole-transcriptome Salmon quantification completed previously; this package re-extracts its selected gene estimates, not raw reads. Caris assay-matched November percentiles supersede the old universal-low-expression interpretation.

runs.reference: GENCODE v37 comprehensive chromosome transcript FASTA; GRCh38.p13
runs.index: k31; GENCODE identifier parsing; exact duplicate transcript collapse default
runs.mode: paired original reads; automatic library orientation; default selective alignment
runs.scope: Whole transcriptome before gene aggregation; no target-only denominator
limitations: Transcriptome-only index, without genomic decoys or personalised HLA alleles
No UMI collapsing or PCR duplicate removal; chemistry insufficiently specified
Capture, specimen composition and biological timing differences remain
Bootstrap variation is technical allocation uncertainty, not biological replication
runs.portable_command_template: salmon quant -i INDEX -l A -1 R1.fastq.gz -2 R2.fastq.gz -g GENE_MAP -p THREADS --seqBias --gcBias --allowDovetail --numBootstraps 30 --sigDigits 8 --no-progress -o OUTPUT
